title: Understanding Reconstruction Error
text: Reconstruction error in PCA is related to how well the first principal component can capture the variance in the data. The more variance it captures, the lower the reconstruction error.

title: Analyzing Pair A
text: Look at the spread of the data points in Pair A. How does the variance along the principal component compare to the variance perpendicular to it?

title: Analyzing Pair B
text: For Pair B, consider the direction of the data spread. How aligned are the data points along a single line?

title: Analyzing Pair C
text: In Pair C, observe the distribution of points. Is there a clear direction where most of the variance is captured?

title: Choosing the Pair with Lowest Reconstruction Error
text: Which pair shows the least spread perpendicular to the direction of maximum variance?
